title: Earlier Missed-Visit Fees and the Same-Day Cancellation Fee — Appointment Series Questions Answered
content:
Training questions on the repeat share in the same-day cancellation fee of an Appointment Series.

**The rule.** The same-day repeat share is 150 percent where the series already shows two or more missed-visit fees assessed in the two months up to the assessment date (an entry counts when fewer than two whole months separate its date from the assessment date), 125 percent where it shows exactly one such fee, and 100 percent where it shows none. The share is read as a percentage of the same-day basis and multiplies it.

**Which fees count?** Every missed-visit fee entry already standing on the same series, of any kind, by the date it was assessed.

**One such fee entry in the period — what share?** 125 percent.

**Three entries?** 150 percent, as for two.

**The only entry is dated exactly two whole months before the assessment date?** It does not count; the share is 100 percent.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** Assessment on 12 October with fee entries dated 13 August and 2 October: two entries count, so 150 percent; on a same-day basis of USD 40.00 that is USD 60.00.
